implementation.kind: Readable Round-3 SHAKE/SHA3 Saber-family KEM; ordinary ring arithmetic and backend-independent high-level logic
implementation.security_scope: Research reference with secret-bearing trace; no constant-time, validated module, analog hardware, or measured-performance claim.

api.keygen: keygen(seed_a,seed_s,z)->(ek,dk); each input is a raw 32-byte randomness draw
api.encaps: encaps(ek,m)->(K,c); m is the raw 32-byte randomness draw before the official SHA3-256 preprocessing
api.decaps: decaps(dk,c)->K; byte type/length checks at entry, ordinary Saber valid small-secret decapsulation key required
api.optional_randomness: Omitted keygen/encaps random inputs use secrets.token_bytes(32), without a validation claim for the platform RNG
api.pke_decrypt: pke_decrypt(dk_pke,c)->message recovers SHA3-256(m_raw) for valid encapsulations
api.parameters: PARAMS maps LightSaber/Saber/FireSaber to frozen dataclasses with k,mu,et,eta,h1,h2,ek_len,dk_pke_len,dk_len,ct_len
api.counts: counts {poly_dot,polynomial_products}; phase_counts keyed keygen/encaps/decaps/other; reset_counts also resets auxiliary engine counters
api.engine: self.engine is auxiliary_ntt.SaberPolynomialEngine for matrix/rram_binary, None for schoolbook

byte_exact_rules: KeyGen draws seed_Araw then seed_s; seed_A=SHAKE128(seed_Araw,32). The seed stored at the end of ek is seed_A, not raw seed_A.
GenMatrix SHAKE128 expands k*k*416 bytes and decodes 13-bit coefficients in row-major matrix order.
GenSecret SHAKE128 expands k*32*mu bytes. Each coefficient is popcount(mu/2 low bits) minus popcount(the next mu/2 bits), little-endian.
KeyGen computes A^T*s, adds h1=4, shifts by3, and keeps10 bits. Encaps computes A*sprime with the same rounding.
Secret key encodes each signed CBD coefficient in its low13 bits, then appends ek, SHA3-256(ek), z.
Saber message subtraction uses512*message_bit. Compression and message recovery use the reference h1/h2 and power-of-two masks.
Ciphertext is k packed10-bit polynomials followed by one packedet-bit polynomial.
Shared key=SHA3-256(prekey||SHA3-256(ciphertext)). Decapsulation replaces prekey with z on reencryption mismatch.
The stored H(ek) is used directly in decapsulation, matching official Saber; no ML-KEM-specific public-key hash check is inserted.

arithmetic.ring: Z_m[X]/(X^256+1), m=8192 for matrix products or1024 for ciphertext/public-vector inner products
arithmetic.centering: Each left operand is centered modulo the target modulus; each right secret is independently centered modulo8192, never modulo the target1024. Valid generated secrets lie in[-5,5],[-4,4],[-3,3] respectively.
arithmetic.schoolbook: Independent shifted ordinary-convolution rows using exact NumPy int64 multiply/add, then subtract degree>=256 terms. No transform, FFT or dense-matrix call.
arithmetic.matrix_rram: Only _dot delegates to SaberPolynomialEngine(backend,trace).dot(left,right,modulus,stage). All sampling, packing, rounding, hash and FO code is shared.
arithmetic.rounding_equivalence: Canonical reduction modulo8192/1024 before shifts is byte-equivalent to official uint16 arithmetic: discarded multiples become multiples of the final packed field modulus.

trace.representation: bytes remain bytes; arrays may be nested lists or NumPy ndarrays; emitted dictionaries are deep snapshots
includes: matrix coefficients and sampling stream offsets
CBD bits, positive/negative popcounts, signed and canonical secrets
polynomial inputs, outputs, backend and phase
independent schoolbook ordinary convolution, negacyclic folding and accumulated sums
auxiliary NTT/INTT/binary-bank events provided by the selected engine
q-to-p rounding, message embedding/subtraction, p-to-t rounding, recovered message bits
FO reencryption, comparison, selected prekey and KDF

verification_at_creation.official_smoke: Official KAT count0 for each of LightSaber,Saber,FireSaber: pk,sk,ct,ss,decaps byte-exact on schoolbook backend
verification_at_creation.additional_smoke: One independent seed tuple per family: complete roundtrip, pke recovered message equals H(raw_m), tampered ciphertext gives H(z||H(c)).
verification_at_creation.full_suite: check_golden.py executes all 300 official cases on the rram_binary backend by default, yielding 1500 serialized-output comparisons. Independent arithmetic oracles are checked separately by check_auxiliary.py.

release_preparation.scope: Portable binary-weight reference with documented APIs, deterministic local weight regeneration, official KAT and independent arithmetic validation
release_preparation.local_changes: Comments/docstrings, source regeneration, portable optional C audit, binary-only default validation and strict 0/1 artifact checks; fixed official C/KAT files unchanged

physical_weights.dense_matrices: Modular integer coefficients used for weight generation and correctness oracles, not conductances
